title: Agent Certificate v0 AgentRevision Registry Record
description: The MINIMAL blinded commitment record for AgentRevision registration in the certificate program (C1 Ruling 3, 'Corrected AgentRevisionV0 boundary allowlist', binding). The complete boundary allowlist is: fixed schema discriminator · server-assigned opaque revision ID (response only) · commitment/canonicalization scheme enums · BLINDED revision commitment · optional parent revision reference 'only if lineage is approved as a disclosure' · server-computed canonical record digest 'excluding the assigned ID'. REMOVED from v0 and unrepresentable here: material_kind_counts, item counts, date buckets ('Precise timestamps remain server-internal' — there is no timestamp field of any kind). The idempotency digest 'must be calculated over the canonical request record before ID assignment' — 'A canonical idempotency digest cannot include a server-assigned ID without becoming circular.' PRINTED NON-CLAIMS (required at registration, C1 Ruling 3): registration does not prove 'ownership, semantic uniqueness, source contents, successful build, testing, deployment, current deployment binding, or drift monitoring'; a parent reference 'asserts a declared link only, not chronology or derivation'; 'Registration does not establish that the server lacks the preimage through another channel' (current-online already discloses tuned free-text configuration values through another channel); 'Fresh-blinding re-registration and semantic duplicates are not prevented' — 'Random salts allow the same underlying object to be re-registered under fresh commitments. A unique digest does not establish semantic uniqueness.' Reversal condition: 'admit a structured field only when a named consumer cannot operate on the commitment alone and its disclosure cost is explicitly approved.' This is a DIFFERENT record family from agent_lifecycle_record/'s ALR-1106 registration routes — it does not replace them; it is the certificate-boundary commitment shape those richer routes must project down to before anything crosses into a certificate. Root instance is one registered record (the response shape); the request shape is #/definitions/RegisterRequestV0.

RegisterRequestV0.description: Create-once registration request: scheme enums plus the secret-blinded commitment. No counts, no date buckets, no free text, no client-supplied identifiers. parent_revision_ref crosses only because lineage was conditionally approved as a declared-link disclosure; omit it when lineage is not being disclosed.

blinded_revision_commitment.description: Secret-blinded commitment to the client-local canonical revision manifest. The blinding material stays client-local; a public salt would not prevent low-entropy guessing (merged prohibited claim 22).

parent_revision_ref.description: Optional declared parent revision. 'asserts a declared link only, not chronology or derivation' (printed non-claim).

AgentRevisionRegistryRecordV0.description: The immutable registered record (create-once/get-by-ID; DB-enforced immutability and non-null server-derived idempotency are conceded architecture, enforced server-side). canonical_record_digest is server-computed over the canonical RegisterRequestV0 record BEFORE revision_id assignment, excluding the assigned ID. There is deliberately no created_at: precise timestamps remain server-internal, and no date bucket may cross.

revision_id.description: Server-assigned opaque revision ID (response only; never client-supplied).

parent_revision_ref.description: Echoed only when the request disclosed lineage. 'asserts a declared link only, not chronology or derivation' (printed non-claim).

canonical_record_digest.description: Server-computed canonical digest over the request record before ID assignment ('excluding the assigned ID' — including it would be circular).
